title: SOVCTX Mathematical Foundation to Applied Engineering Transfer Graph
evidentiary_policy: Lines are strictly divided between DOCUMENTED_LINEAGE (supported by primary citations) and HYPOTHESIZED_LINEAGE (plausible mathematical foundations requiring primary bureau records).

transfer_lines.label: Tikhonov Inverse Theory to Geophysics & Radar Antenna Synthesis
transfer_lines.core_mathematical_formulation: A z = u (Fredholm first-kind) => min ||Az - u||^2 + alpha * Omega[z]
applied_engineering_domains: Магнитотеллурическое зондирование (МТЗ) в геофизике
Синтез диаграмм направленности антенн и фазированных решеток (РЛС)
Вычислительная газовая динамика и теплозащита космических аппаратов (гипотеза)

lineage_milestones.role: Formulates stability of inverse problems for geophysics in DAN SSSR
Applies regularization to magnetotelluric geological prospecting
Publishes monograph 'Constructing a Radiating System from a Specified Radiation Pattern'
Samarsky and Tikhonov regularize finite-difference hydrocodes for re-entry and nuclear physics

next_acquisition_targets: Zelkin 1963 monograph full text (Сов. радио) for direct equation concordance
IPM Keldysh technical reports on re-entry boundary layer finite difference schemes
transfer_lines.historical_summary: Tikhonov's regularization arose directly from geophysical sounding where surface measurements must invert electromagnetic diffusion to recover underground conductivity layers. By 1963, this exact Fredholm operator framework was transferred by E. G. Zelkin into Soviet radar engineering to synthesize antenna apertures from desired radiation patterns without producing infinite reactive fields. The transfer to spacecraft heat-shield hydrocodes remains a plausible candidate lineage requiring bureau archival evidence.

transfer_lines.label: Chebyshev-Lyapunov-Andronov-Pontryagin to Optimal Flight & Guidance Control
transfer_lines.core_mathematical_formulation: dot(x) = f(x, u), u in U => H(x, psi, u) = (psi, f) => max_{u in U} H
applied_engineering_domains: Теория оптимального управления летательными аппаратами
Релейные системы ориентации спутников (bang-bang control)
Траекторная оптимизация сближения на орбите (NASA Apollo 1963 / ОКБ-1)
Теория дуального управления Фельдбаума

lineage_milestones.role: General Problem of the Stability of Motion

lineage_milestones.entity: Андронов А. А. & Понтрягин Л. С.
lineage_milestones.role: Introduction of structural stability (rough systems)
Discovery of the Maximum Principle with bounded control sets
Theory of optimal regulation for aircraft and rocket trajectories
Application of Pontryagin Maximum Principle to Apollo lunar orbit rendezvous trajectories
Implementation of relay attitude control in lunar/interplanetary probes

next_acquisition_targets: Krasovskii N. N. 1959-1962 monographs on stabilization and flight dynamics
NII-885 / OKB-1 technical documentation for Vostok/Soyuz orientation logic
Feldbaum A. A. 1960 papers on dual control theory in Avtomatika i Telemekhanika
transfer_lines.historical_summary: Starting from Lyapunov's phase-space stability and Andronov's non-linear oscillations, Pontryagin formalized optimal control with hard actuator constraints (u in U). While international adoption for space trajectories is documented (e.g. NASA's 1963 Apollo rendezvous studies), specific Soviet design bureau transfer chains to OKB-1/NII-885 guidance micro-logic remain candidate hypotheses awaiting primary source acquisition.

transfer_lines.label: Vlasov-Bogolyubov Kinetic Theory to Tokamak Equilibrium & Plasma Confinement
applied_engineering_domains: Магнитное удержание плазмы в установках Токамак (Т-3, Т-4, Т-10)
Равновесие плазменного шнура (уравнение Града — Шафранова)
Высокочастотный нагрев плазмы и гиротроны NIRFI (гипотеза)

lineage_milestones.role: Formulates collisionless kinetic equation with self-consistent field
Derives kinetic equations from BBGKY hierarchy of classical mechanics
Derives Grad–Shafranov MHD equilibrium for toroidal plasma pinches

lineage_milestones.entity: Курчатов И. В. & Арцимович Л. А.
lineage_milestones.role: T-3 Tokamak achieves thermonuclear temperatures confirming magnetic confinement
Development of gyrotrons for ECRH plasma heating

next_acquisition_targets: Shafranov V. D. 1958 Atomnaya Energiya papers on toroidal plasma equilibrium
Artsimovich L. A. 1969 IAEA Novosibirsk conference reports on T-3 Tokamak
Gaponov-Grekhov A. V. NIRFI technical reports on relativistic gyrotrons
transfer_lines.historical_summary: Vlasov's realization that long-range Coulomb interactions dominate over local pair collisions provided the macroscopic foundation for high-temperature plasma dynamics. Grounded by Bogolyubov's BBGKY hierarchy, this theory transferred directly through Shafranov and Artsimovich into Tokamak magnetic equilibrium and stability analysis, making this one of the most rigorously documented Soviet scientific transfers.

transfer_lines.label: Gelfand-Levitan-Marchenko Inverse Spectra to Solitons & Nonlinear Wave Optics
transfer_lines.core_mathematical_formulation: K(x,y) + F(x,y) + integral_0^x K(x,s) F(s,y) ds = 0 => q(x) = 2 dK(x,x)/dx
applied_engineering_domains: Нелинейная волоконная оптика и оптические солитоны
Интегрирование нелинейных эволюционных уравнений (КдФ, НУШ)
Синтез акустических и гидроакустических профилей скорости
Квантовая обратная задача рассеяния

lineage_milestones.entity: Гельфанд И. М. & Левитан Б. М.
lineage_milestones.role: Derives linear integral equation reconstructing Sturm–Liouville operator
Solves inverse problem of scattering theory for one-dimensional Schrodinger operator
Establishes multi-dimensional inverse scattering and quantum three-body equations
US discovery of inverse scattering transform for KdV

lineage_milestones.entity: Захаров В. Е. & Шабат А. Б.
lineage_milestones.role: Applies inverse scattering transform (IST) to integrate nonlinear Schrodinger equation

next_acquisition_targets: Zakharov V. E., Shabat A. B. 1971 ZhETF paper on exact theory of 2D self-focusing
Faddeev L. D., Takhtajan L. A. Hamiltonian Methods in the Theory of Solitons (1986)
transfer_lines.historical_summary: The transformation operator method developed by Gelfand, Levitan, and Marchenko proved that an inaccessible spatial potential can be reconstructed exactly from boundary spectral data. In 1971, Zakharov and Shabat at the Landau Institute proved that this inverse spectral apparatus integrates nonlinear wave equations, establishing modern soliton theory in close, productive interaction with contemporary Western discoveries by Lax, Gardner, Greene, Kruskal, and Miura.

transfer_lines.historical_summary: Confronted with high degrees of freedom in physiological motor control, Gelfand and Tsetlin adapted Bernstein's motor synergies into a mathematical theory of non-local search and dynamic partitioning. This directly influenced Tsetlin's adaptive finite automata in random environments and Glushkov's variable-structure cybernetic architectures, supported by unambiguous primary documentary citations.

next_acquisition_targets: BESM-6 standard subroutine library documentation (VTS AN SSSR)

transfer_lines.historical_summary: Chebyshev's uniform approximation originated in Watt steam engine linkage design. In the 20th century, his minimax equioscillation polynomials became foundational for analog and digital filter synthesis worldwide. While BESM-6 served as the premier scientific supercomputer for the Soviet space and nuclear programs, the specific claim that Chebyshev polynomials formed its core microcode remains a candidate hypothesis requiring verified compiler/microcode assembly listings.
